verdict.rationale: Jitsu's docs describe a Management API, CLI, and MCP server for configuring individual destinations, streams, and functions, and mention event-level batching/deduplication for data delivery, but there is no evidence of a bulk operation capability (e.g., bulk create/update/delete across many pipeline items or records) that an AI agent could invoke in one call. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch config endpoints or CLI commands, evidence of multi-item operations via MCP or API, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
